profile.name: Brooke Drassal Equine Bodywork
profile.description:
Drassal Equine Bodywork is where horse owners, trainers, and practitioners learn how to help their horses perform and feel better.

Hey there, I'm Brooke Drassal. I created this channel to provide you with easy-to-follow massage tips and exercises you can do every day with your horse. Plus, you'll get insights and takeaways from top pros in the industry about horse training, rehabilitation, complementary therapies, and so much more.

So if you're a horse enthusiast that loves to stay on the cutting edge of equine performance and ways to keep your four-legged partner in tip-top shape, subscribe to my channel now.

And stay on the lookout for new videos with expert interviews, actionable how-to's, and my thoughts on everything from using FES to help kissing spine to my go-to liniments.

pages.excerpt: Home Equine Therapy WORK WITH ME FES MASSAGE THERAPY WHAT TO EXPECT SUCCESS STORIES Massage Gun Course Freebies Free Equine Massage Training Understanding and Preventing Colic in Horses Coaching About Blog Log In Select Page About Brooke Helping Horses Feel Their Best is My Passion Work with me I’ve spent my entire life around horses…Now, I’m able to help them live their best lives. Hey there, I’m Brooke Drassal. I hopped on my first horse at age 2, a very naughty shetland pony with a will and a mind all her own. From that moment on, I was hooked. Over the last decade, I’ve been living and breathing equine rehabilitation and injury prevention. Between conducting original research with Dr. Sheila Schils on the efficacy of FES to receiving multiple degrees and certifications as an equine practitioner, my goal has always been to help my clients have happier, healthier, and more comfortable horses. And that’s why I… Take a step-by-step approach No more throwing solutions against the wall and seeing what sticks. I spend time fully evaluating your horse, consulting with your veterinarian, and developing a therapy plan based on tested and proven techniques. Listen to both clients and horses Helping your horse mentally and physically feel top notch is just as important as his ability to perform. That’s why I’ll always be honest about what I can do to help you achieve your goals while making sure we’re staying true to your horse’s best interest. Customize Every Therapy Plan No two horses are alike and neither should their therapy plans. Whether your horse needs FES, massage, or a combination of therapies, I’ll come up with a tailored plan to fit his needs, your expectations and budget. Quite honestly I’m in heaven when I can work with any horse, any discipline.
